item.title: Pantone's 2026 color: 'Cloud Dancer' soft white for calm
item.description: Pantone named "Cloud Dancer" as its 2026 Color of the Year, a soft white intended to bring calm and clarity into homes. The color "Cloud Dancer" is described as a soft, airy white that serves as a canvas for various home decor styles. item.title: Scottsdale's Parada del Sol celebrates 72 years of Western fun
item.description: The 72nd annual Parada Del Sol Parade will take place in Old Town Scottsdale this Saturday, celebrating the city's Western heritage and honoring the 75th anniversary of Old Town Scottsdale with a parade featuring approximately 150 entries and a Trail's End Festival with various entertainment stages.

item.title: Arizona Renaissance Fest: Mix of cosplay and history
item.description: The Arizona Renaissance Festival is happening Saturdays and Sundays now through March 29th. The annual event features jousting, comedy performances and medieval-themed food across 50 acres of festival grounds. item.title: Arcadia Little League boosts Taipei ties with baseball exchange
item.description: The Arcadia Little League team from Arizona recently traveled to Taiwan to play exhibition games and visit Taipei, Phoenix's sister city, in an effort to strengthen international relations through baseball.

item.title: Sun Devil Curling Team hosts qualifier, fundraises for nationals
item.description: The Sun Devil curling team is hosting the "Inferno on Ice" West Coast Regional Qualifier this weekend to raise money and compete for a spot in the college national championships.

item.title: Phoenix Mahjong Club: A social hub for analog hobbies
item.description: The Phoenix Mahjong Club in Scottsdale, Arizona is the first member-based Mahjong club in the state, offering a social alternative to digital entertainment and providing a way for people to build meaningful connections away from their smartphones.

item.title: Cupid cash and Valentine's specials at Bucky's and Yavapai Casinos
item.description: Bucky's and Yavapai Casinos are offering a variety of Valentine's Day promotions, including Cupid Cash Drawings, Table Games Kisses and Cash Hot Seats, and romantic dinner specials, for players to win prizes and enjoy a romantic night out.

item.title: WM Phoenix Open partners with Waste Not to share surplus food
item.description: The nonprofit organization Waste Not is partnering with the WM Phoenix Open to redistribute unused food from the tournament to local residents in need. item.title: Elevated dining with runway views at Volanti restaurant
item.description: Volanti Restaurant at Scottsdale Airport offers a unique dining experience with runway views, accessible to the general public without a plane ticket or security screening, and features a menu of approachable fine dining with a variety of popular items and creative cocktails.

item.title: Volunteers boost WM Phoenix Open's fundraising success
item.description: The WM Phoenix Open is powered by over 3,500 volunteers who manage nearly every aspect of the tournament, which generated $18.1 million in proceeds for the local community last year and has given back over $226 million over nine decades.
